app.title: Tabernetes: A Kubernetes cluster whose nodes are browser tabs
app.description: A Kubernetes cluster that runs each node inside a separate browser tab, enabling lightweight local clusters and experimentation without a VM.
proposed_tests: Execute `tabernet start` and verify pods reach Ready state
Deploy a sample Helm chart and confirm service accessibility
Measure cluster boot time and compare to kind
